artist.name: Aaliyah
artist.profile:
American Singer, Actress, dancer, and Model. 

Born January 16, 1979, in Brooklyn, New York City, USA.

Aaliyah released 3 albums within her lifetime: "Age Ain't Nothing But A Number", "One In A Million" and her praised self-titled album, "Aaliyah".

Aaliyah starred in 2 movies, "Romeo Must Die" and posthumously, "Queen of the Damned".

Daughter of [a1772573], sister of [a666565]. Niece of Record Executive [a348491] and (by marriage) Soul legend [a135244]. Cousin of record executive [a171166] and rapper [a803218].
Married to controversial R&B Singer/Producer [a14646] from 1994-1995 (annulled). At the time of passing, in a relationship with (and had reportedly planned to marry) Hip-hop mogul [a174951].

Upon releasing her debut album "[m=100995]" in 1994, Aaliyah gained a steadily growing reputation for helping to redefine contemporary R&B, pop and hip hop, earning her the nicknames the "Princess of R&B" and "Queen of Urban pop".
A sophomore album "[m=101004]" was released in 1996, and her final album, "[m=35220]", appeared earlier in the year of her tragic death.

Aaliyah unfortunately died on August 25, 2001, in Marsh Harbour, Abaco Islands, The Bahamas (Aged 22) in an Airplane crash that also claimed the lives of 8 others after filming the music video for her single "Rock The Boat", featured on her third album, "Aaliyah".

Aaliyah's posthumous works range from 1 Movie and 2 singles: "Poison featuring The Weeknd" released in 2021 and "Gone featuring Tank" released in 2025.

Aaliyah has sold an estimated 24 to 32 million albums worldwide, alongside over 8 million certified sales in the United States.
